title: Execute Firestore Backup Export in Backup
description: Answer: How do I execute firestore backup export? This is the canonical Backup workflow for execute-firestore-backup-export.
prerequisites: You are signed in as admin and can access Backup.
Route /backup is reachable and module data is loaded without blocking errors.
Required records and permissions for execute-firestore-backup-export are available before execution.
steps: Verify active workspace/company context before running execute firestore backup export.
Open the exact workflow action labeled for execute firestore backup export.
Enter required fields for execute firestore backup export (entity selection, date range, and status where applicable).
Apply changes and execute execute firestore backup export with explicit confirmation in the UI.
Use print/export controls and confirm file preview/download generation completes.
Validate result rows/totals/artifacts on the same page before navigating away.
If output is generated (report, export, invoice, or link), verify it is accessible and associated with the same context.
Record resulting reference IDs or filenames for traceability and follow-up.
validations: The execute-firestore-backup-export action completes without permission or validation errors.
Resulting state is visible immediately in Backup lists, metrics, or related output panels.
Output artifacts remain linked to the same entity/date context used during execution.
commonErrors: No data returned because filter/date/entity scope is missing or inconsistent.
Action appears successful but output record is not persisted or linked.
recovery: Reopen /backup, reapply field values, and rerun execute-firestore-backup-export with a narrowed scope.
Refresh session and confirm role permissions for admin before retry.
Cross-check logs/output panes and relink missing artifacts to the correct context.
